Usage: loadout [<options>] <command> [<args>]...

  Set up a machine from a shared config repo and track installed program
  versions. v{{VERSION}}

Options:
  -V, --version     Show the version and exit
  --repo=<text>     Path to the config repo (default: $LOADOUT_REPO, then the
                    current directory)
  --machine=<text>  Machine name for state tracking (default: hostname)
  -v, --verbose     Verbose output
  -h, --help        Show this message and exit

Commands:
  status             Observe this machine: every program version and script
                     check re-asked, drift explained, state file updated.
                       --json      print the full state as JSON
                       --no-write  observe without touching the state file
  explain            Explain programs, scripts or configs: the fully expanded
                     definition exactly as the engine sees it.
